statement_nl: For a nonzero polynomial M(q) in Q[q], let Loc_M be the localization of the Laurent polynomial ring Q[q,q^{-1}] obtained by inverting every polynomial V(q) in Q[q] with gcd(V(q),M(q))=1. For rational functions X(q),Y(q) in Q(q), write X(q) ≡ Y(q) mod M(q) if X(q)-Y(q) belongs to the ideal M(q)·Loc_M.
